<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" /></noinclude><section begin=par134 />omission of {{GHGheb|text=יוֹם}} in all these cases see under ''n''; only in late passages is {{GHGheb|text=יוֹם}} added, e.g. {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 Ch|chapter=29|verse=17}} {{GHGheb|text=בְּיוֹם שְׁמוֹנָה לַחֹ֫דֶשׁ}}; {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ezr|chapter=3|verse=6}} {{GHGheb|text=מִיּוֹם אֶחָד לַחֹ֫דֶשׁ}}.—Finally, when the year is stated by {{GHGheb|text=בִּשְׁנַת}} governing a determinate ordinal, viz. {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=17|verse=6}} {{GHGheb|text=בִּשְׁנַת הַתְּשִׁיעִית|translate=in the ninth year}}; {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=25|verse=1}} (in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=52|verse=4}} {{GHGheb|text=בְּשָׁנָה}}), {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=28|verse=1}} {{GHGterm|K<sup>e</sup>th.}}, 32:1 {{GHGterm|K<sup>e</sup>th.}}, 46:2, 51:59, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ezr|chapter=7|verse=8}}; {{GHGheb|text=בִּשְׁנַת}} in such cases is again (see note 2 on ''o'') to be explained according to {{GHGpar|128|k}}. This is supported by the fact that the Masora on {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=28|verse=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=32|verse=1|hidebook=1}} requires in the {{GHGterm|Q<sup>e</sup>rê}} {{GHGheb|text=בַּשָּׁנָה}} for {{GHGheb|text=בשנת}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|134|q}}
'''5.''' ''Distributives'' are expressed either by repetition of the cardinal number, e.g. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=7|verse=9}}, 15 {{GHGheb|text=שְׁנַ֫יִם שְׁנַ֫יִם|translate=two and two}}; {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=21|verse=20}} {{GHGheb|text=שֵׁשׁ וָשֵׁשׁ|translate=six each}}; with the numbered object also repeated, e.g. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jos|chapter=3|verse=12}} {{GHGheb|text=אִישׁ אֶחָד אִישׁ אֶחָד לַשָּֽׁבֶט|translate=for every tribe a man}}; {{GHGbible-ref|book=Nu|chapter=13|verse=2}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Nu|chapter=34|verse=18|hidebook=1}} ({{GHGheb|text=אֶחָד מִן}}, as in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Neh|chapter=11|verse=1}}, ''one out of every ten''); cf. {{GHGpar|123|d}}; or a periphrasis with {{GHGheb|text=אֶחָד לְ}} is used, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Nu|chapter=17|verse=18}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=1|verse=23}}, cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=6|verse=2}} {{GHGheb|text=לְאֶחָד}} after ''six wings'' twice repeated; the simple distributive {{GHGheb|text=לְ}} is, however, sufficient (as in {{GHGheb|text=לַבְּקָרִים}}, {{GHGpar|123|c}}), e.g. {{GHGheb|text=לְמֵאוֹת וְלַֽאֲלָפִים|translate=by hundreds and by thousands}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|134|r}}
'''6.''' The ''multiplicatives'' are expressed either (like the ordinals above 10, see under ''o'') by the cardinals (in the feminine, probably owing to the omission of {{GHGheb|text=פַּ֫עַם}}, {{GHGheb|text=פְּעָמִים}}; so König, {{GHGcite|title=Lehrgeb.}}, ii. 228), as {{GHGheb|text=שְׁתַּ֫יִם|translate=twice}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=40|verse=5}}; {{GHGheb|text=שֶׁ֫בַע|translate=seven times}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=26|verse=21}}, 24, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Pr|chapter=24|verse=16}}; cf. also {{GHGheb|text=אַחַת|translate=once}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=6|verse=10}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=40|verse=5}}, for which in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=33|verse=14}} {{GHGheb|text=בְּאַחַת}}<ref>But {{GHGheb|text=בְּאַחַת}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Nu|chapter=10|verse=4}} is to be translated ''on one'' (trumpet).</ref> along with {{GHGheb|text=בִּשְׁתַּ֫יִם}} (the latter also in {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=18|verse=21}}); or by the ''dual'' of the numeral, thus {{GHGheb|text=שִׁבְעָתַ֫יִם}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=4|verse=15}} (in verse 24 along with the cardinal 77 for 77 times); {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=30|verse=26}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=12|verse=7}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=79|verse=12|hidebook=1}}; {{GHGheb|text=אַרְבַּעְתָּ֑יִם}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=12|verse=6}};<ref>Probably also {{GHGheb|text=כִּפְלַ֫יִם}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=11|verse=6}} (from {{GHGheb|text=כֶּ֫פֶל|translate=doubling}}) does not mean ''doubled'' but ''manifold''.</ref> or periphrastically by {{GHGheb|text=פַּ֫עַם|translate=a time}} (prop. ''a step'', with the article, {{GHGheb|text=הַפַּ֫עַם|translate=this time}}; cf. also {{GHGheb|text=בַּפַּ֫עַם הַזֹּאת}}, with {{GHGheb|text=בְּ}}, like {{GHGheb|text=בְּאַחַת}} above), as {{GHGheb|text=פַּ֫עַם אַחַת|translate=once}} ({{GHGbible-ref|book=Neh|chapter=13|verse=20}} {{GHGheb|text=פַּ֫עַם וּשְׁתַּ֫יִם|translate=once and twice}}), {{GHGheb|text=פַּֽעֲמַ֫יִם|translate=twice}}, {{GHGheb|text=שָׁלשׁ פְּעָמִים}} (for which in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=23|verse=14}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Nu|chapter=22|verse=28}}, 32 {{GHGheb|text=שָׁלשׁ רְגָלִים}}) ''three times''; cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=41|verse=6}} ''thirty-three times''; {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=24|verse=3}} ''an hundred times''; {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=1|verse=11}} ''a thousand times''; {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=22|verse=16}} {{GHGheb|text=עַד־כַּמֶּה פְעָמִים|translate=until how many times}}, i.e. how often. Cf. also {{GHGheb|text=עֲשֶׂ֫רֶת מֹנִים|translate=ten times}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=31|verse=7}}, 14, and {{GHGheb|text=רַבּוֹת עִתִּים|translate=many times}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Neh|chapter=9|verse=28}}.—In {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=43|verse=34}}, ''five times'' is expressed by {{GHGheb|text=חָמֵשׁ יָדוֹת}} (prop. ''five hands''),<ref>But {{GHGheb|text=אַרְבַּע הַיָּדוֹת}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=47|verse=24}} means ''the'' (other) ''four parts''; cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=11|verse=7}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Neh|chapter=11|verse=1}}.</ref> and in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=16|verse=5}} the ''double'' is expressed by {{GHGheb|text=מִשְׁנֶה עַל־}} (prop. ''a repetition over and above that which'', &c.).—Of the ordinals {{GHGheb|text=שֵׁנִית}} is used as a numeral adverb, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=22|verse=15}}, &c., ''a second time'', cf. the Latin ''tertium consul''; {{GHGheb|text=בַּשְּׁלִישִׁת|translate=the third time}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=3|verse=8}}; {{GHGheb|text=פַּ֫עַם חֲמִישִׁית|translate=a fifth time}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Neh|chapter=6|verse=5}}; {{GHGheb|text=בַּשְּׁבִעִית|translate=at the seventh}} (time), {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=18|verse=44}}, and {{GHGheb|text=בַּפַּ֫עַם הַשּׁ׳}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jos|chapter=6|verse=16}}.
